_comment: Template for a layer-combination sweep. Copy into a study directory as
sweep.json and replace `combos` with the combinations you are registering.
`config_template` is resolved relative to this file first, then to the
repository root. Run `python -m improvements.sweep plan --spec <this file>`
before anything else: it is read-only and prints exactly what would run.

policy.concurrency_basis: HUMAN OVERRIDE, <date>: AGENTS.md invariant 16 caps concurrent GPU training jobs at two; the researcher authorised an automatic, resource-derived cap for this sweep instead. Record the authorisation, do not leave this blank.

remote._comment: Set host to the pod's ssh target before any remote verb (push/pull/start/status/logs/stop). The placeholder is refused there with a clear message; plan/configs/report never touch the network.
